propositions: A bug_trends lens with five dimensions (close_class-by-month, detected_by, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by fan-in, time-to-close percentiles) must be registered in the rebar metrics registry following the same pattern as gate-economics sidecar metrics.

Pre-convention bugs lacking close_class (~214 pre-convention-era records) must surface as an explicit MISSING labeled cohort in the close_class distribution rather than being silently dropped or merged with other classes.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) must filter on close transition timestamp within the ctx since/until range, while stock dimensions (open-bug age, detected_by, caused_by fan-in) must report point-in-time measures over the current store and deliberately ignore the range.
Sparse or absent detected_by field must degrade that dimension to unavailable state per registry convention without affecting other dimensions or crashing.
Empty bug stores must return unavailable state per registry convention, and the lens must handle mixed-era stores and incomplete detected_by population gracefully.
